description.value: Common Loaf Bake Shop is a cafe located in Tofino, British Columbia, at the western end of the Pacific Rim corridor — a popular destination for touring cyclists completing routes across Vancouver Island. The business was verified as active in OpenStreetMap as recently as December 2025 and accepts both credit and debit cards. Its position in Tofino makes it a potential rest stop for cyclists arriving via Highway 4 or the Tofino–Ucluelet shared-use path.
